visual.general_description: Color endoscopic (colonoscopy) image of colonic mucosa in a circular field with three blue arrows.
visual.detailed_description: Circular endoscopic field with black vignette corners. The mucosa is red to pink, with a visible branching vascular pattern on the left half and a smoother, brighter and more saturated red region on the right where light reflection is strongest and a fine honeycomb-like surface pattern is visible. A mucosal fold runs from the upper center toward the lower center. Three horizontal blue arrows point from the left toward small dark red to brown focal spots: one in the left-center mucosa, one near the central fold, and one at the dark patterned patch at the far right edge. Small white specular reflections and bubbles are scattered, mostly at the lower left. No panel letters, text labels, timestamps, scale bar or device overlay are visible.

caption_claims.value: Caption states multiple punctate erosions and flaky ulcers covered with white exudate (arrows) in the sigmoid colon. Erosion, ulcer and exudate characterization is an author claim; the arrow targets look like small dark spots and a white exudate layer is not distinguishable at this resolution.
